The first note's "Rifponf." is probably "Respons." but is printed this way on the scan. Line 4 of the first paragraph has a pale, partly illegible passage between "vestram" and "imaginem". The running head includes the chapter marker "(Cap.1." as printed. The mark "e" appears twice in the margin: the note for Bozius and the note beside "Qui nolunt"; the second is set as a note in the text, so I transcribed it inline.
